description: Official Progress Agentic RAG Hex Loop graphic device. Always reference this file rather than drawing, tracing, or approximating a hexagon. Use only as a cropped layout element — never shown in full or as a standalone graphic.

files.name: hex-loop-rgb
files.use: RGB / screen artwork. Use for web, demo UIs, decks, and any digital asset.

baseFill.note: Blue P2 — the solid base of the device.

gradientOverlay.note: Near-black blue applied as directional linear-gradient overlays at 0–70% opacity across multiple facets. These gradients create the tonal depth and 3D faceting.

colors.confirmedPalette: Blues only — no orange. This resolves the source-guideline discrepancy documented in references/hex-loop.md.

structure.geometry: Two concentric hexagonal rings on the 30° isometric grid, constructed from faceted polygonal shapes with gradient overlays.
structure.clipPath: The outer hexagon clips all content via a clipPath element.
structure.innerHexagon: A smaller concentric hexagon creates the 'loop' negative space.

cropping.rule: Always crop the Hex Loop so it bleeds off an edge of the layout. Never show it in full. See references/hex-loop.md for crop selection guidance.
cropping.technique: Use CSS overflow:hidden, SVG viewBox manipulation, or a clipping mask on the container to crop the device. The SVG itself should remain unedited — crop at the layout level, not by modifying the SVG paths.

examples.rightBleed: Place the SVG so its left half is visible and the right half extends beyond the container edge.
examples.topLeftBleed: Position so the bottom-right quarter is visible inside the layout, with the rest bleeding off the top and left.
examples.bottomBleed: Position so the top half is visible, bottom half extends below the container.

prohibitions: Never show the full hexagon in layout — always crop.
Never recolor any part of the device.
Never use as a standalone graphic, icon, or illustration.
Never rotate off the 30° isometric grid.
Never use two crops in multi-product material — use the Progress Helix instead.
Never let it compete with the logo for attention.
gaps: Only an RGB variant has been supplied. A CMYK/print variant may exist in the Brand Bank — request it for print-specific deliverables.
No PNG raster fallback is bundled. Rasterize the SVG at the needed resolution if PNG is required.
